latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Free Video Maker AI.

- Instantly turns uploaded images and video clips into professional videos with music and text in under a minute.
- No editing skills required; simply describe your desired output and get an MP4 download.
- Supports MP4, MOV, JPG, and PNG files up to 500MB.
- Free usage includes 100 credits, with jobs processed in the cloud and export always free.
- Ideal for small business owners and content creators seeking fast, automated video creation.
